blocks.title: TrackMania United Transformation Pack
blocks.tagline: Unofficial visual and sound update for TrackMania United Forever; textures from TrackMania 2 and ManiaPlanet.

items.title: Environment textures
items.text: Textures from TrackMania 2 for every environment except Snow, Island and Coast.

items.title: Menu textures
items.text: Menu textures replaced with those of ManiaPlanet 3.

items.title: HUD
items.text: The TrackMania 2 vignette overlay and no background behind the level name.

items.title: Sounds
items.text: New menu, engine, surface, impact and environment sounds, some taken from TrackMania 2.

images.caption: In-game screenshot from the project repository
Night driving, the about image of the project

blocks.title: Install
blocks.markdown: The pack replaces textures and sounds. Download, installation help and legal notes are on the project site.
